connector.name: PubNub MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: PubNub Model Context Protocol MCP Server for Cursor and Claude
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pubnub account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PUBNUB_API_KEY
env.description: Your PubNub API Key. Required for all operations related to your account/keyset

env.name: PUBNUB_PUBLISH_KEY
env.description: Optional PubNub publish key for real-time operations

env.name: PUBNUB_SUBSCRIBE_KEY
env.description: Optional PubNub subscribe key for real-time operations

env.name: PUBNUB_USER_ID
env.description: Optional variable that can be provided to change the User ID for the SDK (real-time) operations (default: pubnub-mcp)

env.name: PUBNUB_EMAIL
env.description: (Deprecated - use API Key instead) Your PubNub account email. Required for all operations related to your account/keyset

env.name: PUBNUB_PASSWORD
env.description: (Deprecated - use API Key instead) Your PubNub account password. Required for all operations related to your account/keyset
